dataSource.query:
SELECT AVG((SELECT LAST(END_TIME) - FIRST(END_TIME))) AS "Cycle time"
FROM THIS_PROCESS
LIMIT 500

SELECT (SUM("duration") / COUNT("duration"))/1000000000 AS "duration"
FROM FLATTEN((SELECT *
FROM THIS_PROCESS) AS sub)
WHERE "duration" IS NOT NULL AND "concept:name" = 'call_llm'
LIMIT 500

SELECT DISTINCT "ai:model" AS "LLM Model"
FROM FLATTEN((SELECT *
FROM THIS_PROCESS) AS sub)
WHERE "ai:model" IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 500

SELECT SUM((SELECT SUM("ai:input_tokens"))) AS "input tokens", SUM((SELECT SUM("ai:response_tokens"))) AS "response tokens", SUM((SELECT SUM("ai:response_tokens"))) + SUM((SELECT SUM("ai:input_tokens"))) as "total"
FROM THIS_PROCESS
LIMIT 500

SELECT COUNT(CASE_ID) AS "Cases"
FROM THIS_PROCESS
LIMIT 500

SELECT AVG("unique_agents")
FROM (
	SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ai:agent_name") AS "unique_agents", "CASE_ID" AS "Case ID"
	FROM FLATTEN((SELECT *
	FROM THIS_PROCESS) AS sub)
) AS subsub
LIMIT 500

SELECT DISTINCT "ai:tool_name" AS "Tool", "ai:agent_name" AS "used by"
FROM FLATTEN((SELECT *
FROM THIS_PROCESS) AS sub)
WHERE "ai:tool_name" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "used by"
LIMIT 500

SELECT "sum_input_tokens" AS "input cost", "sum_response_tokens" AS "output cost", "sum_response_tokens" + "sum_input_tokens" as "total cost" FROM(
SELECT ((SUM((SELECT SUM("ai:response_tokens")))/1000000) * 8) AS "sum_response_tokens", ((SUM((SELECT SUM("ai:input_tokens")))/1000000) * 2) AS "sum_input_tokens", SUM((SELECT SUM("ai:response_tokens"))) + SUM((SELECT SUM("ai:input_tokens"))) as "sum_total"
FROM THIS_PROCESS
LIMIT 500) AS "sub"

SELECT SUM("ai:response_tokens") + SUM("ai:input_tokens") AS "ai:total_tokens", "org:resource"
FROM FLATTEN((SELECT *
FROM THIS_PROCESS) AS sub)
WHERE "ai:response_tokens" IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 500

SELECT "sum_response_tokens" + "sum_input_tokens" as "total cost" FROM(
SELECT ((SUM((SELECT SUM("ai:response_tokens")))/1000000) * 8) AS "sum_response_tokens", ((SUM((SELECT SUM("ai:input_tokens")))/1000000) * 2) AS "sum_input_tokens", SUM((SELECT SUM("ai:response_tokens"))) + SUM((SELECT SUM("ai:input_tokens"))) as "sum_total"
FROM THIS_PROCESS
LIMIT 500) AS "sub"
